mentions.name: skrl
mentions.description: A language for defining keyboard shortcuts and key remaps, released as an open-source project.
mentions.audience: The author notes it is useful at least for personal use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I released just yesterday something I've been working on: skrl [1], a language for defining keyboard shortcuts and remaps. Found a few bugs already, but it's still useful at least to me personally.
